question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank is describing individuals who have gained a profound understanding of transcendental knowledge.
 
• The word "deep" is most appropriate in this context, as it emphasizes the intensity and depth of their knowledge.
 
• Using "deep" conveys that their knowledge is comprehensive and insightful, aligning with the philosophical tone of the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"But for those who have **deep** transcendental knowledge, all three are almost same and there is not much difference among these three."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Large transcendental knowledge" – Incorrect, as "large" refers to size or quantity, not the intensity of understanding.
 
• **Option 3:** "Superficial transcendental knowledge" – Incorrect, as it conveys a lack of depth, which contradicts the context.
 
• **Option 4:** "Depth transcendental knowledge" – Grammatically incorrect in this context.
